content:
name: bot

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled]

jobs:
  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: jacogr/action-merge@d2d64b4545acd93b0a9575177d3d215ae3f92029
        with:
          checks: pr (build),pr (lint),pr (test)
          labels: -auto
          strategy: squash
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_BOT }}
